ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, high-intensity contiguous white patch along the outer distal margin. Both lobes exhibit diffuse, fine-grained linear white striations. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity with sparse white focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal pixel angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along both trailing edges; left lobe displays more uniform peak-to-valley amplitude (approx. 3-5 pixels) than the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes. A smaller cluster of three white spots is visible on the upper surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of parallel, high-intensity linear scratches located on the lower-left lobe. A single prominent diagonal linear mark is visible on the inner-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified protrusions on the distal tips of both lobes, creating significant irregularity in the expected smooth geometric contour of the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated circular white mark with a distinct dark center (ocellus-like) located on the upper-mid region of the right lobe.
